name: Proxy
description: Sentinelle algorithmique détectant les anomalies suspectes et les comportements inhabituels dans les systèmes amis.

loadout.armor_outfit: Corps partiellement cybernétiques avec circuits lumineux sous la peau. Implant neural à la tempe. Yeux bleus numériques. Interfaces holographiques flottantes.
loadout.arsenal: Equipment designed to channel and amplify the character's death ability (self_on_flip) — visible energy conduits integrated into the gear

attitude.behavior: Everyday working pose, natural stance — character shown in their normal operational state — Death transformation — body shifting on being captured, power released in final burst

style.rendering_style: gritty_realistic_with_cinematic_OSL, high detail on character features, faction-specific material accuracy

palette_names.name: Neon Cyan
palette_names.role: primary_accent — circuit patterns and holographic interfaces

palette_names.name: Electric Blue
palette_names.role: secondary_accent — data streams and eye glow

palette_names.name: Matte White
palette_names.role: tertiary accent — base clothing and clean geometric lines

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Flat ambient light with subtle shadows, documentary-style natural lighting

camera.angle: eye-level direct portrait creating a sense of honest documentation

scenography.setting: Digital server cathedral at the heart of the network, towering columns of processing units reaching into endless data streams, holographic pathways suspended in zero gravity
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Glitching holographic displays, floating data panels streaming information, electric arcs between conductors, digital particles dissolving and reforming, plus final sacrifice — dramatic release of accumulated energy at the moment of defeat visible in the environment

card_metadata.description: Sentinelle algorithmique détectant les anomalies suspectes et les comportements inhabituels dans les systèmes amis.
card_metadata.faction_lore: L'Omni-Réseau est l'entité numérique connectant des millions de consciences à travers la galaxie. Toute information est une arme, chaque donnée un soldat.
card_metadata.frame_detail: Brushed steel frame with simple geometric pattern, no ornamentation, utilitarian finish
card_metadata.composition_directive: Medium close-up portrait (chest-up) showing character face and upper torso in their working environment
card_metadata.seed_note: For reproducibility: maintain exact faction color palette, frame style by rarity, and ability visualization as described
